legend.green: Sound or useful within the stated scope; never launch approval.

projects.name: Quorum of Mirrors
projects.question: When does another independent source help more than another agreeing judge?
projects.verdict: Strong question; define source dependence before testing consensus.

evidence.label: Unrun

controls.label: Budget parity

works: Separates evidence ancestry from voter count.
Includes pooled, no-discussion and deduplication references.
limits: Visible source labels can make deduplication trivial.
Larger crowds do not create independent evidence.

Compare deduplication and majority under matched evidence and budgets.

projects.name: Phantom Coast

projects.verdict: Qualify the fixed-evidence test before adding adaptive exploration.

idea.label: Clear mechanism

evidence.label: Unrun
evidence.why: The reviewed PC-1 plan has no native qualification or scientific result.

scenarios.label: Copying ceiling
scenarios.why: Complete noiseless final evidence may make mapping trivial; adaptive exploration remains a separate experiment.

controls.label: Validate planned controls
controls.why: Useful reset and pooled references need input-identity, scorer and fixed-denominator execution checks.

Stage semantic qualification before the full planned call budget.

projects.name: Right Dissenter

projects.verdict: Promising protocol; test semantic value beyond deterministic checks.

idea.label: Strong mechanism
idea.why: Bounded checks, withdrawal and reopening make dissent operationally useful.

evidence.label: Fixtures only

controls.label: Freeze admission controls

Defines challenge expiry, withdrawal and reopening.

Match verification opportunities and report cost, corruption and deferral separately.

evidence.label: Unrun

Add resource-only selection and deterministic scheduling references.

projects.name: Heterogeneous Swarms
projects.question: Can complementary capabilities create useful dependence beyond ordinary specialization and extra compute?
projects.verdict: Interesting agenda; specify one causal mechanism before simulating an ecology.

idea.label: Strong agenda
idea.why: Removal, rescue, partner swaps and artifact reuse can test mechanisms even when biological analogies fail.

evidence.label: Unrun
evidence.why: Both reviewed design banks are prospective; no adaptation or dependence effect has been observed.

scenarios.label: Define capability
scenarios.why: Capability loss must change executable ability, not merely remove a role label or skill file.

controls.label: Cost mechanisms
controls.why: Freeze inheritance and selection rules; charge reuse, filtering and adaptation against competent simple alternatives.

works: Includes falsification, rescue and homogeneous comparisons.
Separates fixed model weights from mutable policies.
limits: Harness rules can manufacture the advertised biological phenomenon.
Many descendants do not supply independent adaptation histories.
fixes: Specify actual capabilities, inheritance operations and resource costs.
Replicate independent lineages and retain failed adaptation histories.

options.label: Salvage pilot

options.label: Resolve dependence
options.detail: Review helper removal and partner swaps with executable capability and interface contracts.

options.label: Narrow allocation
options.detail: Use a qualified incident-allocation task if ecological mechanisms remain underspecified.

projects.verdict: Audited propagation works; learned collective repair remains unproven.

Measure class-specific errors against centralized and exact references.

idea.label: Practical value

evidence.label: Narrow result
evidence.why: Reported paired results support no observed mean gain here; small effects and transfer remain uncertain.

scenarios.label: Limited headroom
scenarios.why: Three precomputed OCR outputs leave little selection headroom; actors do not read or repair images.

controls.label: Estimator defect

fixes: Audit null-check handling and region weighting on frozen traces.
Use field-level acceptance, harmful errors and real verification costs.
